stories.title: Spain win the FIFA World Cup 2026
stories.body: beat Argentina 1-0 after extra time on 19 July at MetLife Stadium, New Jersey (Ferran Torres, 106th minute); 2nd title (first since 2010); first country to hold the men's and women's titles simultaneously; Kylian Mbappé takes the Golden Boot.

stories.title: England win the ODI series 2-1 against India
stories.body: Ben Duckett's 141 at Lord's on 19 July is a record ODI innings at the venue (beating Viv Richards' 138* in the 1979 World Cup final); England's first bilateral ODI series win over India since 2018; Rohit Sharma scores 138 for India.
